Utilization Management Department

Notice of Adverse Determination - Medical Necessity

Date of Notice: [[LETTER_DATE]]
Member ID: MBR779445100
Claim Number: CLM38692115170
Service Reviewed: Inpatient admission, Community-acquired pneumonia, DRG 194
Dates of Service: [[ADMIT_DATE]] through [[DISCHARGE_DATE]]
Criteria Set Applied: MCG-style criteria, current edition in effect on the date of admission

DETERMINATION

Cascade Mutual has completed review of the above inpatient admission and has issued an adverse determination, medical necessity. Benefits for the inpatient level of care billed under DRG 194 for the period [[ADMIT_DATE]] through [[DISCHARGE_DATE]] are denied.

BASIS FOR DETERMINATION

The documentation available at the time of admission did not meet inpatient criteria.

The following guideline codes were reviewed and found not met:

PNA-01: Not met. The patient did not have hypoxemia requiring inpatient oxygen.

PNA-03: Not met. Mental status was at baseline.

No additional guideline codes were applied to this adverse determination, medical necessity.

CLAIM ADJUSTMENT CODING

This determination is transmitted with the following codes: CARC CO-50; RARC N115.

APPEAL RIGHTS

You or your authorized representative may request reconsideration of this adverse determination, medical necessity. Appeals must be submitted in writing and addressed to Utilization Management, Cascade Mutual.

To support efficient review, the written appeal should:

1. Reference the guideline code at issue - PNA-01 or PNA-03 - and respond to the specific finding stated above for each argument presented.
2. Identify the records, pages, or entries relied upon for each argument.
3. Include the following physician attestation line, completed and signed by the treating or reviewing physician: "I attest that the clinical information submitted in support of this appeal is accurate and was documented during the admission under review."

Appeals must be received by [[APPEAL_DEADLINE]]. Appeals received after that date may be closed without clinical review.

This notice addresses medical necessity for the inpatient level of care only. The member is not liable for charges denied under this determination except as permitted by the applicable plan document and provider agreement.

A copy of the guideline codes applied is available to the treating provider upon written request to Utilization Management.

Sincerely,

Medical Director, Utilization Management
Cascade Mutual
